2. The petitioners as Pre-remptors filed Miscellaneous Case No.85 of 1997 before the learned Assistant Judge, Rajbari for pre-emption of the case land under Section 96 of the State Acquisition and Tenancy Act, 1950, on contending inter alia that they are co-sharers by purchase and contiguous land holders and the opposite parties transferred the case land beyond the knowledge of the pre-emptors, by registered kabala dated 29.05.1997, and the same was registered under section 60 of the Registration Act on 17.07.1997. 

 3. The opposite party Nos.1-3 of the case, contested the case by filing written objection and contended inter alia, that the case is bad for defect of parties, pre-emptors are not co-sharers of the case holding not contiguous land owner and also stated that the preemptors negotiated the sale and thereby barred by principle of waiver acquiescence and estoppel and accordingly prays for dismissing of the case. 

 6. It appears from the deposition of P.W.1, Md. Farman Khan who is opposite party No. 1 of the case and deposed on behalf of the opposite party Nos.2 and 3 during his examination in chief stated that the purchase Kabala of the peremptors and impugned Kabala under peremption were executed and presented for registration on the same day and also stated that the pre-emptors were present at the time of registration of the Kabala under question. It also appears that the pre-emptor No.1 as P.W.1 admitted during his cross examination that; “লগ্ন দক্ষিণে আলিমুদ্দিন খার বাড়ী। তার দক্ষিণে (তেলামুদ্দিন কবলা গ্রহীতার পিতা) তেলামুদ্দিন বাড়ী। আমাদের বাড়ী ও নালিশী জমির মধ্যে সরকারী হালুট (রাস্তা) আছে। আমাদের বাড়ীর দাগ নম্বর ৬৮৮৮, ৬৯২০ নম্বর দাগ। নালিশী জমির দাগ পশ্চিমে তেলামুদ্দিনের (প্রতিপক্ষ) ও গফুরের জমি আছে। আমার জমি গফুর মুন্সির পরে। নাঃ জমির লাগ উত্তরে নাজিমুদ্দিন। নাঃ জমি দিয়ারা দাগ ৬৭৮৮। এই দাগের লগ্ন ৬৭৯৩(উত্তরে) আজিম, জালাল খায়। নালিশী জমির লগ্ন ৬৭০৯ দাগ খায় গনি মোল্লা। লগ্ন ৬৭৭৯ দাগ (দিয়ারাধ) খায় আব্দুস ছাত্তার। ৬৭৮৬ দাগ খায় দুঃখী বেপারী, ৬৭৮১ দাগ খায় দুঃখী বেপারী, ৬৭৮১ দাগ খায় জলিল ও গফুর মুন্সি খায়। ৬৭৮৫ দাগ খায় দলিল মুন্সি। ৬৭৮৬ দাগ খায় আলিমুদ্দিন।” From which it appears that the pre-emptors are not contiguous land owners as in between the case land and their land a pathway belonged to Government is there and also did not impleader all the contiguous land owners in the case.
